purpose: Shape every finding must have before it is rendered into prose. Validated by scripts/viora.py with the standard library only - no jsonschema, no network.

constraints.rule: severity must be one of the enum values
constraints.why: An invented severity cannot be ordered, so the report cannot rank by exploitability.

constraints.rule: verdict must be one of the enum values
verdict UNDETERMINED must not carry a severity
constraints.why: Severity is impact x reachability. If reachability is unknown the product is unknown, and a number there reads as measurement that never happened.

constraints.rule: a finding with a verdict other than UNDETERMINED must carry a severity
constraints.why: A judged finding without a severity cannot be gated on.
